Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting expenditures for works of art at correctional facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to expenditures for works of art; and amending RCW43.17.200.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.17.200 and 1983 c 204 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All state agencies including all state departments, boards,councils, commissions, and quasi public corporations shall allocate, asa nondeductible item, out of any moneys appropriated for the originalconstruction of any public building, an amount of onehalf of onepercent of the appropriation to be expended by the Washington statearts commission for the acquisition of works of art. The works of artmay be placed on public lands, integral to or attached to a publicbuilding or structure, detached within or outside a public building orstructure, part of a portable exhibition or collection, part of atemporary exhibition, or loaned or exhibited in other publicfacilities. In addition to the cost of the works of art the onehalfof one percent of the appropriation as provided herein shall be used toprovide for the administration of the visual arts program by theWashington state arts commission and all costs for installation of the p. 1 HB 2014works of art. For the purpose of this section building shall notinclude correctional facilities as defined in RCW 70.48.020, or highwayconstruction sheds, warehouses or other buildings of a temporarynature.
